description: Starts recording a new commitment by an investor in one of the user’s funds. The assistant resolves the fund and the investor, asks for what is missing, and puts the commitment to the user for confirmation before anything is written.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their own words

team.description: The team to act on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise

timeZone.description: The user’s IANA time zone, such as America/New_York

name: capital_company_create_commitment
title: Record an investor’s commitment
